messages:
Sam: heads-up: hit a weird consistency bug in staging with shared-slab enabled. tenant-42 lost a few demote tokens and tenant-77 suddenly served stale prefix entries for ~25s. anyone seen cross-tenant stale reads like this?
Ivy: can you drop the minimal repro + logs?
Sam: sure. repro: create two micro-tenants (42,77) on the same shard, make 42 hot, trigger eviction contraction, observe handback messages then stale reads on 77. snippet: 
```
2026-02-12T03:04:12Z INFO evict: tenant=42 demote=4 -> slab=3
2026-02-12T03:04:13Z INFO handback: shard=3 from=42 -> to=77 tokens=2 gen=15
2026-02-12T03:04:37Z ERROR readpath: tenant=77 stale-prefix key=0xab12 gen=15
```
Rohit: oh, the handback includes gen=15 — we currently treat tokens as opaque credits. that gen was never validated by the receiver when slab is shared.
Lea: sounds like an ownership/timing window problem: the receiver accepts tokens and assumes metadata is current. but if ownership transitioned recently the metadata may point to a different prefix layout. we need validation before accepting cross-tenant tokens.
Carlos: options: (A) ban cross-tenant handbacks entirely (safe but hurts memory efficiency), (B) quarantine incoming tokens for a brief period, (C) attach owner_generation and check against local lease/epoch before accept.
Ivy: (C) looks promising. attach owner_tenant + owner_generation. receiver consults local lease_epoch or owner_map, and only accepts if owner_generation <= local_safe_generation. otherwise reject tokens -> trigger local cold-prefill.
Sam: example accept logic: 
```
// run on receiver
bool acceptHandback(Handback h) {
  if (h.owner_tenant == my_tenant) return true;
  if (h.owner_generation <= leaseManager.safe_generation(h.owner_tenant)) return true;
  if (h.tokens <= SMALL_FASTPATH) return true; // avoid tiny rejects
  return false; // force rebuild/prefill
}
```
Rohit: implementation notes: leaseManager.safe_generation(...) is already broadcast for slab ownership via the lease subsystem. reusing that avoids extra RPCs.
Lea: caveat: rejecting many handbacks will increase rehydrate load. we should pair rejection with a jittered backoff + proactive prefill (server can request prefix prefill from global fetcher). also emit metrics: handback.accepted, handback.rejected{reason=gen_mismatch}.
Carlos: cursor/callsite state: long-lived cursors may reference prefix generation. on resume we should assert prefix.gen == cursor.expected_gen; if mismatch return INVALID_CURSOR and force client to re-open. add a resume-fail metric.
Ivy: tests: (1) chaos test where owner flips rapidly and verify no stale reads, (2) micro-benchmark to measure extra cold-prefill rate, (3) integration to ensure small_fastpath prevents high-frequency tiny rejects.
Sam: work items: 1) add owner_generation to handback RPC + wire through serialization (Rohit) 2) expose leaseManager.safe_generation to receiver (Rohit/Carlos) 3) implement acceptHandback + small_fastpath (Rohit) 4) add cursor generation checks (Lea) 5) alerts + dashboards for handback.rejected and readpath.stale (Ivy) 6) temporary ops knob: disable shared-slab for customers sensitive to cross-tenant moves.
Rohit: estimate: prototype tags + accept logic in ~2 days; full safe_generation integration + tests ~1 week.
Lea: I'll own the cursor test + integration. Ivy can you draft the alert thresholds?
Ivy: yes. suggest paging on readpath.stale > 5/min per shard or handback.rejected rate > 1% of handbacks for 10m.
Carlos: add a small e2e that simulates micro-tenants to catch regressions in CI.
Sam: thanks. I'll file INF-9901 tracking this and link to RFC for prefix-cache refactor. leaving the failing staging repro in the eviction-runbook folder if needed. :thumbsup:
evict-bot: Automated note: created ticket INF-9901 (prefix-cache: cross-tenant handback validation + cursor safety) assigned to Rohit, Lea.
